title: Muted gold
text: Muted gold. The sequins on this pillow are very muted. I suppose I thought it would be a lot shiner or sparkle a lot more. If you are looking for something that has a muted gold, then this can work for you. Because the sequins are a little rough, this is really more of a decorative pillow than one you would actually use. I had no problems with the quality. This would look nice on a sofa or with holiday decorations. You can only spot clean it; it is not to put in the machine. Overall, I wish it were a little more sparkly.
